key_findings.finding: Yes. The directly relevant paper is Jacobsen et al., “Genome wide association study identifies variants in NBEA associated with migraine in bipolar disorder” (Journal of Affective Disorders, 2015; PMID 25451450). It analyzed 460 bipolar-disorder patients with migraine versus 914 bipolar-disorder patients without migraine in the Bipolar Genome Study (BiGS), all reported European-American ethnicity. The discovery GWAS identified intronic NBEA variant rs1160720 (HGNC NBEA/neurobeachin; HGNC:7648) at genome-wide significance: P=2.97×10^-8, OR=1.82, 95% CI 1.47–2.25.
